name: Implement QAOA (p=1) from scratch in Qiskit to solve MaxCut on the graph with ed
task_prompt: Implement QAOA (p=1) from scratch in Qiskit to solve MaxCut on the graph with edges [(0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 3), (0, 4), (1, 2), (1, 3), (1, 4), (2, 3), (3, 4)]. Build the cost and mixer layers manually, optimize with scipy, and print the best cut found. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
